02-064.r: Last decade: Real GDP growth rate did not rise steadily (fell after 2008 recession); GDP at market prices in rupees rose every year, until COVID-19 made 2020-21 growth negative.
02-064.c: The book's answer (b) fits the question period; its explanation adds that, after the 2020-21 fall, (d) is right for the present scenario.

04-072.r: India → only country producing all five commercial silks (Mulberry, Tropical Tasar, Oak Tasar, Eri, Muga); China largest silk producer, India second. Sugar 2022-23: Brazil first, India second.
04-072.t: India was the largest sugar producer in 2021-22, but in 2022-23 (USDA) Brazil is first.

04-102.r: FSS Act 2006 replaced Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954; FSSAI has an independent Chairperson (Secretary rank) under Health Ministry's administrative control, not under DG Health Services.

04-182.r: Centre no longer fixes Statutory Minimum Price of sugarcane; FRP replaced SMP from 2009-10 (Sugarcane Control Amendment Order 2009); sugar and sugarcane are essential commodities (Essential Commodities Act 1955).
hi: Fair and Remunerative Price (उचित और लाभकारी मूल्य)

04-186.r: CACP recommends MSP for 22 crops (not 32) plus FRP for sugarcane; NFSM (2007-08) is under Agriculture Ministry, not Consumer Affairs. MSP crops include barley, ragi, groundnut, sesamum.
04-186.t: Areca nut, coffee and turmeric get no MSP.

04-212.r: Agri credit share 2022-23: Commercial Banks 76.86%, RRBs 12.34%, all cooperatives only 10.80%, so DCCBs don't lead; DCCBs fund and guide Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS).
hi: Primary Agricultural Credit Society (प्राथमिक कृषि साख समिति)

05-210.r: Jute products → Titagarh; silk textile → Bangalore (Bengaluru); woollen hosiery → Ludhiana; woollen carpet → Bhadohi.

07-256.r: Global Trust Bank → taken over by Oriental Bank of Commerce (2004), not PNB; Kelkar's second report dropped its original call to abolish housing-loan interest exemption, offering two options instead.

09-092.r: Gorewala Committee (All-India Rural Credit Survey) → SBI formed by merging Imperial Bank of India with State-associated banks; six commercial banks nationalised on April 15, 1980.

09-135.r: SIDBI head office → Lucknow (not Mumbai); Allahabad Bank → Kolkata (merged with Indian Bank, 2020); Indian Overseas Bank → Chennai.
09-135.h: SIDBI serves MSMEs from UP's capital, Lucknow.

09-159.r: Internal debt includes market borrowings, Treasury bills and special securities issued to RBI; public debt = internal + external, contracted against Consolidated Fund of India.

09-235.r: Repo rate → rate at which RBI lends to banks (banks borrow from RBI); reverse repo → RBI borrows. Gini coefficient 1 = perfect inequality; 0 = perfect equality.

09-236.r: Bank Rate → RBI lends to banks for long-term needs (rediscounts bills of exchange); Repo Rate → RBI lends for short term. Both statements swap these, so both incorrect.

09-386.r: Credit rating agencies regulated by SEBI (CRA Regulations 1999), not RBI; ICRA is a public limited company (listed BSE, NSE); Brickwork Ratings is a SEBI-registered Indian rating agency.

16-175.r: Post offices exceed 1.5 lakh (159225 in December 2022); BSNL formed 2000 (not 1997); TRAI set up 1997 (not 2000). Only statement 1 correct.
16-175.t: TRAI (1997) came before BSNL (2000); the statements swap the years.

16-187.r: BIS Standard Mark mandatory for all automotive tyres and tubes (from 18 May 2010); AGMARK → agricultural produce, notified by DMI (Agriculture Ministry) under 1937 Act, not FAO.
hi: Bureau of Indian Standards (भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो)

17-300.r: Infant Mortality Rate → deaths of infants under one year per 1000 live births in a year; not deaths within one month, not per 100.
17-300.t: IMR counts deaths before the first birthday, not the fifth.
